notes: Frozen DURA plus multiscale correction; fixed loss = source DURA guard + 0.01 normalized response error.
Use four fixed clean-IQ perturbations at 1% relative RMS; one direction per view cycles by source cache index.
For each source view inject perturbation through its frozen estimated physical action and re-estimate the changed DURA context once before training.
Fit 32768 permitted source IDs with three simulated views and fixed five epochs; no F/TX/V/target reads.
Inference uses only current IQ and DURA, never source clean IQ, perturbations, or synthetic alternate view.
Frozen candidate must complete 168000 x seven Phase1 Main split views with fixed Tri-SIG-TIME SSL and independent truth-last scoring.
GPU3 waits for this conversation existing flow trainer to end, then checks capacity. Synthetic response is a source proxy, not TX identity or evidence of target benefit.
